findings.fix: Add a reference in the module docstrings (e.g. RealClosure.lean and Extension.lean) to the standard source for this construction — Basu–Pollack–Roy Ch. 1 (already the roadmap's main reference), or Lam / Prestel — and to the Real Closed Fields Project discussion the roadmap points to for the ordering interfaces.
findings.issue: The whole development follows the classical Artin–Schreier ordered-real-closure construction (extend preordering by Zorn; properness of the positive weighted-square cone in quadratic and odd-degree extensions; maximal ordered intermediate field of the algebraic closure). This identifiable classical proof plan is credited nowhere in the six new module docstrings, and the description cites only the roadmap.

summary: The PR constructs ordered algebraic real closures following the standard classical Artin–Schreier proof plan (preordering extension by Zorn, quadratic/odd-degree cone properness, maximal ordered subfield of the algebraic closure), but names no textbook or informal source in the code or description. Credit the central construction it follows.
